amendment_reason: The accepted v0.9.0 release replaces bootstrap and release delivery with native-first first-turn launch, isolates the Codex App adapter from the governance core, and retains explicit routing, immutable run authority, quiet callbacks, exact integration, archive observation, cleanup, and bounded v0.8 refresh. The frozen comparison therefore runs on current accepted v0.9.0 authority without changing its experimental design or using its results to alter v0.9.0.

json_pointer_overrides.replacement: After a fresh v0.9.0 authority check, run only the two scheduled blind cases and their three frozen arms with no new telemetry or routing behavior.

interpretation: This addendum pins the frozen retrospective comparison to accepted v0.9.0 and current Codex App authority. A package or host compatibility failure remains a stopping condition and is not evidence for or against a routing arm. No evaluation result was examined while creating this addendum, and the comparison cannot silently change v0.9.0.
